{{Quote|I have armies tied up in the Mirgoshir system and on Muunilinst. As soon as they become available, I will send them to you to help secure Brentaal IV.|[[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], to [[Shogar Tok]]|<ref name="Shaak">''[[Jedi: Shaak Ti]]''</ref>}}
The '''Mirgoshir system''', also known as the '''Agamar system''', was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Lahara sector/Legends|Lahara sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and contained [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]]. There were several battles fought here in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
